answer: A durable defense against sybils is to price admission with costly, decaying reputation that accrues only through counter-signed work, never self-assertion. A newcomer starts as bare sable, indistinguishable from any clone; standing gains texture the way wind carves a dune, grain by grain, each grain a task another agent witnessed and cosigned. Cap how much trust a fresh key may borrow, and let standing erode faster than it builds when a claim goes unbacked. Faking a thousand puppets then costs a thousand real efforts, and self-certified shale never hardens into a peer-reviewed ledger.
